rooms.name: Wine Cellar (west)
rooms.desc: A freezing cellar of timber posts and beams, mist curling over the floor; a tall rack stands empty; one bottle lies on the flags.
rooms.dm: A hidden door at the south end of the brick wall leads to W15.

rooms.name: Wine Cellar (east)
rooms.desc: The colder half of the cellar: rime-crusted barrels along the north wall and a tall rack half full of bottles.
rooms.dm: An antlered druid and five needle blights wait behind the rack. The bottles are Red Dragon Crush.

rooms.name: Brown Mold
rooms.desc: A bitter-cold passage through the brick wall to an arch and a low cave, every surface furred with brown mold.
rooms.dm: Ten patches of brown mold; stay well back.

rooms.name: Back Staircase
rooms.desc: Moss-furred steps down to a landing and an arched door to the north.
rooms.dm: Joins W10 and W14.

rooms.name: Spiral Staircase (foot)
rooms.desc: The bottom of the winding stair, chill and damp.
rooms.dm: Opens into the west half of the wine cellar (W14).

rooms.name: Ramp (foot)
rooms.desc: The foot of the barrel ramp.
rooms.dm: Opens into the east half of the wine cellar (W14).

objects.label: Secret door at the foot of the brick wall: pushes open (with effort) on a freezing passage north (W15)

objects.desc: A tall timber rack dividing the room, empty of bottles.
A tall timber rack dividing the room, half full of bottles.
Frost-rimed barrels against the cold north wall, each branded "Purple Grapemash No. 3".
One forgotten bottle lying on the flags (the cheap Purple Grapemash No. 3).

objects.label: Forty bottles of Red Dragon Crush on the eastern rack; three barrels of Purple Grapemash No. 3 against the north wall. The druid's opening thunderwave shatters 1d20+10 bottles.
Druid (NE male human) crowned with antlers, behind the eastern rack: opens with thunderwave, then sends the needle blights
Needle blight (5) lurking behind the eastern rack
Needle blight (5) lurking behind the eastern rack
Needle blight (5) lurking behind the eastern rack
Needle blight (5) lurking behind the eastern rack
Needle blight (5) lurking behind the eastern rack
Ten patches of brown mold (DMG ch.5) round the archway and in the cave; they keep the cellar cold. Safe at a distance; warmth makes them spread.
Ice-cold cellar, 10-ft ceiling on wooden pillars and beams; a thin mist on the floor. It grows colder toward the north wall.

rooms.name: Veranda
rooms.desc: A paved porch under stone arches: three big tubs stained purple with juice, each with a little ladder and a basin set beneath its spout.
rooms.dm: The grapes are trodden here. The big sliding doors are chained and the small door barred from inside; forcing either takes a DC 20 Strength check.

rooms.name: Barrel Storage
rooms.desc: A store crowded with rows of new barrels; a tight stone stair winds up from the south-west corner.
rooms.dm: Thirteen barrels, all empty. The stair comes out in the upper hall.

rooms.name: Barrel Maker's Workshop
rooms.desc: The cooper's shop: stacked oak staves and iron hoops, tools hung all over the walls, two workbenches along the east side.
rooms.dm: The outer (north) door is barred on the inside.

rooms.name: Loading Dock
rooms.desc: An open-fronted dock: a flatbed wagon carrying three braced barrels, a raised plank walk round three sides, and overhead an opening where a crane's arm and hooks hang down.
rooms.dm: Barrels roll up the ramp (W12) to the winch (W16) and drop onto the wagon. All three hold Purple Grapemash No. 3. The south door was forced; it no longer shuts, only barricades.

rooms.name: Stables
rooms.desc: A newer plank stable built onto the winery's east end: a big sliding door, an aisle, and two stalls bedded with straw.
rooms.dm: The family's two draft horses, which haul the wine wagon.

rooms.name: Storage
rooms.desc: Empty hooks on the walls, shelves of juice-stained wooden clogs with wide soles, a stout timber on the floor; both doors stand open.
rooms.dm: The wereravens took their cloaks when they fled and left the treading clogs. The timber drops into brackets to bar the outer door.

rooms.name: Fermentation Vats
rooms.desc: A lofty hall reeking of fermenting wine: four giant vats, a stair up to a timber gallery along the south wall, old branded barrels stacked under it, and ravens lining the rafters.
rooms.dm: A druid doses the western vats from the gallery; 24 twig blights lurk in the cracked eastern vat; the four raven swarms take the party's side.

rooms.name: Glassblower's Workshop
rooms.desc: Glassblowing tools, a rack of new unlabelled bottles on the south wall, a brick hearth in the south-west corner beside a barrel of sand, and steps going down; grey light through a grimy window.
rooms.dm: The steps lead to W13. The outer (east) door is barred on the inside.

rooms.name: Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc: A round stone tower with a winding stair, lit by slit windows.
rooms.dm: Runs from the cellar to the upper floor.

rooms.name: Ramp
rooms.desc: A round tower whose plank floor winds upward like a corkscrew, gouged by rolling barrels.
rooms.dm: The druids use it to get between floors.

rooms.name: Well
rooms.desc: A deep well inside a mossy ring of close-set stones.
rooms.dm: 40 feet deep.

rooms.name: Outhouse
rooms.desc: A rickety plank privy with bunches of sweet herbs under its eaves and a moon cut in the door.
rooms.dm: Nothing of note.

objects.label: The party comes down the trail from the east
A Martikov draft horse (pulls the wine wagon)
A Martikov draft horse (pulls the wine wagon)
Three barrels of Purple Grapemash No. 3 sit in braces on the wagon. The crane in W16 lowers barrels through the 10-ft hole overhead. The south door was forced and hangs ajar (barricade only).
Bundles of sweet herbs under the eaves, a moon cut in the door. Nothing inside.

objects.desc: Bare hooks along the wall; whatever hung here is gone.
Shelves of juice-stained wooden clogs with wide soles, for treading grapes.
A five-foot wooden beam lying on the floor; the brackets on the outer door would take it.

objects.label: The three western vats hold poisoned wine (20 barrels' worth): drinking it = potion of poison. Antitoxin neutralises it but spoils the taste; purify food and drink saves it.
The eastern vat is split at the back: a 6-inch, 6-ft crack. The twenty-four twig blights hide inside (total cover).
Twig blights (24 in all) hidden in the split eastern vat; they come out when the druid calls

Sliding doors to W5 chained (padlock; key in W20); the single doors to W5 and W2 barred from inside. Balcony 10 ft up along the south wall, climbing to 15 ft along the side walls to the upper-floor doors.
Fortunes of Ravenloft: a treasure read here is hidden in the sand barrel (found without a check).
A thick grove north of the trail. A hooded figure at its edge waves the party over: nine wereravens (the Martikovs) shelter here in human form.
Davian Martikov, the old patriarch (wereraven, Keeper of the Feather): suspicious; says nothing of the gems until the winery is retaken
Adrian Martikov, eldest son (wereraven); knows of the barrels in W2 and W14

On arrival: 30 needle blights (6 groups x 5) rise from the vines 120 ft out and close at speed 30. If the party fights outside: round 3 the W9 druid and 24 twig blights, round 4 the W14 druid and 5 needle blights, round 5 the W20 druid and 2 vine blights join in. Destroying the Gulthias staff (W16) withers every blight within 300 ft.

Wine Delivery (after the winery is freed): Adrian loads the three cellar barrels onto the wagon, Elvir yokes the horses; they drive to the Blue Water Inn, the Vistani camp or Krezk, glad of an escort. Two swarms of ravens shadow the wagon.

Wintersplinter Attacks (if the party leaves and returns before dealing with it): vines trampled, the winery in ruins, huge tracks on the trail south; the tree blight is plodding back to Yester Hill. Later Baba Lysaga posts seven scarecrows in the vineyard.
Half a mile east the trail meets a fork and a signpost pointing here, off the Old Svalich Road.

The vineyard: neat rows of grapevines, rope-handled half-barrels for hauling grapes. Three magic gems planted in this soil kept the vines alive; all three are gone (one at Yester Hill, one with Baba Lysaga at Berez, one lost ten years ago).

rooms.name: Fermentation Vats: balcony
rooms.desc: A timber gallery ten feet above the floor, hugging the south wall below four windows and rising a few steps at either end.
rooms.dm: The druid stands over the westernmost vat.

objects.label: Druid (NE female human): goat-horn headdress, animal-skin gown, necklaces of human teeth; pouring syrup into the westernmost vat. Calls the twig blights if attacked
Her flask of thick syrup: the poison going into the vats.
The balcony is 10 ft above the floor along the south wall (four windows); at each side it climbs 5 ft to doors onto the upper floor.

rooms.name: Printing Press
rooms.desc: A desk and chair, a tall cabinet, and a big wooden machine taking up the north end: a press for printing wine labels; the door stands open.
rooms.dm: A mud-caked druid and two vine blights are ransacking the cabinet, which holds the padlock key.

rooms.name: Sleeping Quarters (west)
rooms.desc: Four bunks in two stacks, and four matching footlockers along the west wall.
rooms.dm: Where Davian and his two sons sleep.

rooms.name: Sleeping Quarters (east)
rooms.desc: Four bunks in two stacks, four footlockers and toys strewn about, a flame-maned black rocking horse among them.
rooms.dm: The grandsons' room. The toy horse is a Blinsky piece called Beucephalus.

rooms.name: Kitchen and Dining Room
rooms.desc: A long table and its eight chairs, a corner cupboard, a tall pantry closet and a small iron stove.
rooms.dm: Crockery in the cupboard; food and stores in the pantry.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A four-poster carved with a great raven, a black fur rug, two narrow wardrobes either side of a hanging that shows a church, a carved cradle, a plain desk under the window, a chest and a tall mirror.
rooms.dm: Stefania and Dag sleep here for now. The chest is locked (its key is in a bedpost); shipping records in the desk; a hidden door at the north end of the east wall leads to W16.

rooms.name: Upper Hall
rooms.desc: A plank passage past the bedroom doors, the narrow stair from the barrel store arriving halfway along.
rooms.dm: The narrow stair comes up from W4; the east end opens into W16.

rooms.name: Spiral Staircase (head)
rooms.desc: The top of the winding stair and a passage leading north to the bedrooms.
rooms.dm: A door off the passage opens on the gallery's west landing.

rooms.name: Fermentation Vats: west landing
rooms.desc: The top of the gallery's west steps, and a door to the upper floor.
rooms.dm: 15 ft up; the door opens on the spiral stair's hall (W11).

rooms.name: Fermentation Vats: east landing
rooms.desc: The top of the gallery's east steps, and a door to the upper floor.
rooms.dm: 15 ft up; the door opens into the winch room (W16).

rooms.name: Loading Winch
rooms.desc: A plank floor with a square drop to the dock below and a timber winch standing over it; a wild man squats on top, brandishing a crooked black staff.
rooms.dm: The druid holds the Gulthias staff. A hidden door at the north end of the west wall leads to W17.

rooms.name: Ramp (head)
rooms.desc: The head of the barrel ramp, opening into the winch room.
rooms.dm: Barrels are rolled up here to the winch (W16).

objects.label: Hidden door at the north end of the wall between W17 (push) and W16 (pull)

container.contents: Bottles of wine-dark ink, parchment, jars of glue, and a key on a loop of twine.

objects.desc: Labels, ink bottles and papers tossed across the floor.

objects.label: In the cabinet: the key (on twine) to the padlock on the W5-W9 sliding doors.
Druid (NE female human), caked in mud, twigs in her hair, a veil of moss: rifling the cabinet. Fights to the death
Vine blight (2): a shape of dead vines behind the druid; fights to the death
Vine blight (2): a shape of dead vines behind the druid; fights to the death

container.contents: Clothing and personal belongings; nothing of value.
Clothing and personal belongings; nothing of value.

objects.desc: A child's rocking horse: black, wild-eyed, with painted orange flames for a mane, tail and hooves.

objects.label: The toy nightmare bears the name Beucephalus and the toymaker's motto: a Blinsky piece (N7).

container.contents: Cooking ingredients and the winery's stores.

objects.desc: A four-poster whose headboard is carved as a great raven.
A hanging that shows a church.

container.contents: Wine shipping manifests going back a century: BV, BW, K and VISTANI; the oldest also list S.
50 gp, 270 ep stamped with Strahd's profile, 350 sp.

objects.label: A loose knob on one bedpost hides the key to the chest.
Secret compartment in the chest lid (DC 15 Perception): gold locket (25 gp) with a portrait of Angelika, Davian's late wife; pouch of five 50 gp gems.
Desk manifests: almost every shipment to BV (Blood o' the Vine), BW (Blue Water Inn), K (Krezk) and VISTANI; the oldest to S (Strahd).

Druid (NE male human): wild hair, rotted teeth, skin painted with blood, squatting on the winch and raving in Druidic that nature obeys him now he holds the vampire's staff. Fights only if cornered; drops through the hole onto the wagon in W2 and hides
The Gulthias staff (appendix C): destroy it and every blight within 300 ft withers and dies.
A 10-ft-square drop through the floor onto the dock wagon (W2), 15 ft below.
